newsitem.title: USA: Danaher to tender for Exide.
newsitem.headline: Danaher to tender for Exide.

text.p: Danaher Corp, a tool manufacturer, said Wednesday it plans a cash tender offer of $20 per common share for Exide Electronics Group Inc, which makes power supply products.
Danaher said Exide has some 10 million shares outstanding. Danaher owns about 397,000 of those shares.
Danaher said Exide also has outstanding one million preferred shares and warrants to buy about 643,000 common shares at $13.475 each.
Danaher said its offer would not be conditioned on financing.
In a statement, Danaher said it had submitted a letter to Exide requesting that it call a special meeting of shareholders to consider the Danaher bid.
Danaher said it first contacted Exide about a possible business combination on June 11.
Exide officials were not available for comment.
Danaher said it will seek to elect a majority of Exide's board.
